title: School Of Agriculture
description: Sustainable farming practices and modern agribusiness. Precision agriculture, crop improvement, livestock management, soil conservation, agricultural economics, extension services. State-of-the-art greenhouses, tissue culture labs, precision farming equipment. Partnerships with research institutes.

title: School Of Arts And Education
description: Teacher training and creative arts excellence. Pedagogy, curriculum development, educational psychology, fine arts, music, drama, languages. Multimedia studios, performance theaters, digital classrooms, language labs. International teacher exchange programs.

title: School Of Biomedical Sciences
description: Cutting-edge healthcare and medical research. Anatomy, physiology, microbiology, pathology, pharmacology, public health. Modern laboratories, clinical training facilities, research centers, simulation labs. Hospital and clinic partnerships.

title: School Of Engineering
description: Infrastructure and technological innovation. Civil, electrical, mechanical, computer engineering. CAD labs, electronics workshops, fabrication facilities, renewable energy center. Industry internship programs.

title: School Of Home Economics And Social Work
description: Family welfare and community development. Nutrition, family studies, social work, counseling, community health. Demonstration kitchens, counseling centers, community outreach programs. NGO and government partnerships.

title: School Of Management Sciences
description: Business leadership and strategic management. Accounting, marketing, human resources, entrepreneurship, healthcare management. Business incubation center, trading simulation room, executive training suites. Corporate partnerships.
